runs.name: prosody_register_drift
runs.question: does a reworded description of a measured voice keep its measurements
runs.split: 6 of 12 keep every value, 6 change exactly one (rate or f0_span)
runs.why: the same contrast as the wardrobe corpora, moved to prosody: a rewording that drops a unit or rounds a span is drift even when the prose reads the same
runs.curation: tools/corpus-curate.ts style: positive evidence only, a claimed change is kept only if the block value is gone AND a competing value arrived with its unit
runs.outcome: 11 unique pairs, 7 same / 4 different, 0 relabels, 0 drops. curated at likeness voice/corpus/prosody_drift.curated.json

runs.name: style_drift_pairs
runs.question: does a rewrite of a caption keep a measured style profile, or only look like it does
runs.split: 6 of 12 keep every value, 6 change exactly one of sentence_length, ellipsis_rate, hedge_rate, contraction_rate
runs.why: stylometry is the writing half of the same problem the wardrobe corpora test on the visual half: whether a reworded description still measures the same person
runs.curation: a changed_feature claim is kept only if the prose no longer supports that value; a same claim is kept only if nothing measured moved
runs.outcome: 105 unique pairs, 37 malformed (block echoed as the seed), 65 kept, 26 same / 39 different, 10 relabelled, 3 dropped. curated at likeness voice/corpus/style_drift.curated.json

not_used.autoscientist: GET /api/v1/autoscientist lists fine-tuning runs (dataset, model, iterations, target_win_rate, best_win_rate, lora hyperparams). it co-optimises data and a training recipe, it does not read literature. the honest use is training a small drift classifier on the curated corpora, not research.

lesson: a corpus is only curatable where the claim is checkable. numbers with units (prosody) curate clean; prose about garments or habits does not, so those corpora need positive-evidence relabelling and drop counts.
